en.headline: Fire at Richland Gardens in Kowloon Bay evacuates about 150 residents
en.dek: Three people were taken to hospital for suspected smoke inhalation after a blaze broke out in a low-floor unit early on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 九龍灣麗晶花園單位火警 約150名住客疏散
zh.dek: 周三凌晨低層單位起火，三人懷疑吸入濃煙送院，消防正調查起火原因。

en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor sentenced to 2.5 years for unlawful sex with minor
en.dek: The District Court imposed the term on Tuesday after Sei Chun-hing was convicted of intercourse with a girl under 16 in 2011.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施駿興非法性交罪成判囚兩年半
zh.dek: 區域法院周二判刑，施駿興早前被裁定2011年與未滿16歲女童性交罪成。

en.headline: Central Government approves removal of housing chief Winnie Ho
en.dek: The State Council accepted Chief Executive John Lee’s recommendation on Tuesday, formalising Ho’s departure after she resigned over the Tai Po fire.

zh.headline: 中央政府批准免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 國務院周二根據行政長官李家超建議正式免職，何永賢早前因大埔宏福苑火災請辭承擔政治責任。

en.headline: Spanish restaurant Lola María opens second branch on Gresson Street in Wan Chai
en.dek: Chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona’s new outlet began service on 3 November, adding Wan Chai-exclusive dishes alongside the Sheung Wan original’s menu.

zh.headline: 西班牙餐廳Lola María於灣仔機利臣街開設第二分店
zh.dek: 主廚Edgard Sanuy Barahona的新店於11月3日開始營業，在上環原店菜式以外加入灣仔限定菜式。

en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens at Hong Kong Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Broadway adaptation of Roald Dahl’s story begins its Hong Kong run today at the Grand Theatre, with performances through 6 December.

zh.headline: 《朱古力獎門人》音樂劇今起於香港文化中心上演
zh.dek: 改編自羅爾德·達爾作品的百老匯音樂劇，由今日起至十二月六日於尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院公演。

en.headline: Software update triggers four-hour parking meter outage across Hong Kong
en.dek: Transport Department says about 11,000 meters failed after an early software update on Tuesday; system restored by 12.15pm with full refunds arranged.

zh.headline: 凌晨軟件更新致全港咪錶系統故障約四小時
zh.dek: 運輸署指約一萬一千個咪錶受影響，系統於下午十二時十五分恢復，營運商將安排全數退款。

en.headline: UK exempts Hong Kong BN(O) visa holders from proposed 10-year settlement wait
en.dek: British Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood confirmed BN(O) applicants keep their five-year path to settlement but face stricter English-language and criminality requirements.

zh.headline: 英國豁免BNO簽證持有人 不受擬議十年定居期影響
zh.dek: 內政大臣沙巴娜·馬哈茂德確認BNO申請人維持五年定居途徑，但仍須符合更嚴格的英語及品行要求。

en.headline: Local animation Odium Zero holds Hong Kong premiere ahead of cinema screenings
en.dek: The AI-assisted sci-fi work supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency screened its extended first episode on Monday, with special screenings starting 7 November.

zh.headline: 本地動畫《無涯之約》舉行香港首映 11月7日起特別放映
zh.dek: 文創產業發展處支持的人工智能輔助科幻動畫周一首映加長版第一話，本周五起在指定戲院進行特別放映。

en.headline: Health officials urge measles precautions for travellers amid global outbreaks
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection says Hong Kong has recorded nine measles cases this year, mostly imported, and advises checking vaccination status before travel.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心籲外遊市民防麻疹 今年本港錄9宗個案
zh.dek: 中心指本港今年暫錄9宗麻疹，六宗與輸入有關，呼籲計劃外遊者出發前查閱目的地疫情並確保已接種兩劑疫苗。

en.headline: John Lee begins Beijing visit, meets municipal leaders on Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Chief Executive tours the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center and meets Yin Li and Yin Yong to discuss co-operation under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

zh.headline: 李家超展開北京訪問 晤尹力尹勇談北部都會區合作
zh.dek: 行政長官參觀北京城市副中心並與北京市委書記尹力及市長尹勇會面，討論十五五規劃下的合作。

en.headline: Water supply to three buildings in Jordan interrupted after pipe bursts
en.dek: Water Supplies Department expects drinking water to Highview Terrace and Hong Yuen Court to resume around 6am on Wednesday after a main burst on Tak Shing Street.

zh.headline: 佐敦德成街食水管爆裂 高景臺及康源閣三座大廈暫停供水
zh.dek: 水務署指維修鹹水管期間食水管突然爆裂，預計周三早上約六時恢復高景臺及康源閣食水供應。

en.headline: Government defers proxy-vote caps for owners’ meetings after consultation
en.dek: Home and Youth Affairs Bureau says more than half of 550 submissions opposed limits, so it will first strengthen spot checks and verification following the Tai Po fire.

zh.headline: 民青局暫不設業主大會授權票上限 諮詢未達共識
zh.dek: 局方指550份意見中逾半反對設上限，將先加強抽查核實；措施與大埔宏福苑火災後的大廈管理改革有關。

en.headline: Tang says joint task force will seek bid-rigging clues at owners’ meetings
en.dek: Security Secretary tells lawmakers officers will use surveillance and attend corporation meetings to intervene early in building maintenance cases.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強稱特遣隊會到業主大會尋找圍標線索
zh.dek: 保安局局長向立法會議員表示，執法人員會出席業主立案法團會議並以監視等方式及早介入樓宇維修個案。

en.headline: Five Hong Kong universities in Asia’s top 10 as HKU retains first place
en.dek: QS Asia rankings place City University fourth and Chinese University fifth, with three local institutions in the top five for the first time in more than a decade.

zh.headline: QS亞洲大學排名港五校入十強 港大蟬聯榜首
zh.dek: 城大升至第四、中大第五，本港三間大學相隔逾十年再同時位列亞洲五強。

en.headline: Hong Kong retail sales rise 6.4 per cent in September, 17th straight month of growth
en.dek: Provisional figures show total sales value at HK$33.4 billion, with online sales up 12 per cent and jewellery leading category gains.

zh.headline: 本港9月零售業銷貨值按年升6.4% 連升17個月
zh.dek: 臨時估計總銷貨價值334億元，網上銷售升12%，珠寶鐘錶等類別升幅顯著。

en.headline: Special traffic arrangements for World Triathlon Cup in Central and Wan Chai
en.dek: Transport Department says Expo Drive will close from Wednesday and further road closures will apply near the harbourfront on Saturday and Sunday.

zh.headline: 三項鐵人世界盃中區及灣仔分階段實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署指博覽道由周三起封閉，周六及周日中環海濱及灣仔北一帶將進一步封路改道。

en.headline: Hong Kong airport launches single check-in for Hangzhou and Wuhan flights
en.dek: Passengers from the two mainland cities can now check baggage through to overseas destinations via Hong Kong even when changing airlines.

zh.headline: 香港機場啟動杭州武漢聯動一張機票行李直掛服務
zh.dek: 由杭州或武漢出發經香港飛往海外的旅客，即使轉乘不同航空公司，亦可一次辦理登機手續，行李直掛目的地。

en.headline: Hong Kong economy grows 5.2% in third quarter, fastest nine-month pace in five years
en.dek: Advance estimates show real GDP up 5.2% year on year in Q3 and 1.9% on a seasonally adjusted basis, driven by exports and domestic demand.

zh.headline: 本港第三季經濟預估按年增長5.2% 首三季增速創五年最快
zh.dek: 預先估計數字顯示實質本地生產總值按年升5.2%，經季節調整後按季升1.9%，由出口及內部需求帶動。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 132 points for third consecutive gain
en.dek: The benchmark ended at 23,525.97 on Tuesday, rising 0.57% on turnover of more than HK$236 billion as consumer and gaming stocks led gains.

zh.headline: 恒生指數高收132點 連升三日
zh.dek: 周二收報23525.97點，升幅近0.6%，成交額逾2364億元，消費及博彩股帶動升勢。

en.headline: He Lifeng and John Lee address Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit
en.dek: Vice-Premier pledged continued support for Hong Kong as a free open financial centre and more offshore yuan liquidity; Lee said the five-year plan offers investors certainty.

zh.headline: 何立峰與李家超在國際金融領袖投資峰會致辭
zh.dek: 副總理表示將繼續支持香港作為自由開放金融中心並增加離岸人民幣流動性；李家超指五年規劃為投資者提供確定性。

en.headline: Broadway musical Charlie and the Chocolate Factory opens in Hong Kong tomorrow
en.dek: The production based on Roald Dahl’s novel runs at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre from 4 November to 6 December, tickets from HK$388.

zh.headline: 百老匯音樂劇《朱古力獎門人》明日香港開演
zh.dek: 改編自羅爾德·達爾小說的製作由11月4日至12月6日在香港文化中心大劇院上演，票價由388港元起。

en.headline: Parking meter system restored after nearly four-hour outage
en.dek: Transport Department says the citywide system is back to normal after emergency repairs; no evidence of attack, and operator must submit a report within 24 hours.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統已恢復正常運作
zh.dek: 運輸署指營運商緊急搶修後系統復常，暫無證據顯示遭攻擊，並要求盡快提交報告。

en.headline: Red flags hoisted at Stanley, Big Wave Bay and Clear Water Bay beaches
en.dek: Leisure and Cultural Services Department cites big waves; beachgoers advised not to swim at the three sites in Southern and Sai Kung districts.

zh.headline: 赤柱正灘、大浪灣及清水灣第二灣泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署因大浪關係懸掛紅旗，呼籲市民勿在港島南區及西貢區這三個泳灘游泳。

en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor jailed 2.5 years for sex with 13-year-old
en.dek: District Court judge notes lack of remorse in sentencing Sei Chun-hing over an offence from more than a decade ago; he was acquitted of a related indecent-assault count.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施振興因與13歲女童發生性行為判囚兩年半
zh.dek: 區域法院法官指被告缺乏悔意；事件發生於十多年前，另控非禮則被裁定罪名不成立。

en.headline: Parking meter system fails across Hong Kong, police hold off enforcement
en.dek: Transport Department says emergency repairs are under way after the operator reported a malfunction at 8.20am; Secretary Mable Chan says police will not ticket roadside spaces until fixed.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統故障 警方暫不執法路旁泊位
zh.dek: 運輸署接獲營運商早上約8時20分報告系統故障，正緊急搶修；陳美寶指未完全復修前警方不會就路旁咪錶位執法。

en.headline: State Council removes Ho Wing-yin as Housing Bureau Secretary
en.dek: The formal removal follows her resignation last week to take political responsibility for the Tai Po fire, with Michael Wong acting in the post.

zh.headline: 國務院決定免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 何永賢上月為大埔宏福苑火災承擔政治責任請辭，財政司副司長黃偉綸兼任署理局長。

en.headline: Central Government removes Winnie Ho as Housing Secretary
en.dek: The State Council approved the removal on Tuesday following her resignation to take political responsibility for the Wang Fuk Court fire.

zh.headline: 國務院決定免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 中央人民政府周二根據行政長官建議，正式免去何永賢房屋局局長一職，她早前為宏福苑火災承擔政治責任請辭。

en.headline: Parking meter system fails across Hong Kong, police hold off enforcement
en.dek: Transport officials said the operator reported the outage at about 8.20am; Secretary Chen Mei-bo confirmed police would not ticket roadside meter spaces until repairs are complete.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統故障 陳美寶稱未完全復修前警方暫不執法
zh.dek: 運輸署今早約8時20分接獲營辦商報告系統故障，正緊急搶修；運輸及物流局局長表示警方在系統完全復修前不會對路旁咪錶位執法。

en.headline: Spanish restaurant Lola María opens second branch in Wan Chai today
en.dek: Chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona's second Hong Kong outlet on Gresson Street offers Spanish tapas and exclusive local dishes, following the Sheung Wan original.

zh.headline: 西班牙餐廳Lola María今日灣仔開設第二分店
zh.dek: 主廚Edgard Sanuy Barahona在機利臣街的新店提供西班牙小食及灣仔限定菜式，繼上環荷李活道首店後擴展。

en.headline: Runners criticise inaugural Northern Metropolis Marathon arrangements
en.dek: Participants reported water shortages, hot conditions, uneven terrain and a long post-race walk after the event drew about 15,000 runners on Sunday.

zh.headline: 跑手批評首屆北部都會區馬拉松安排
zh.dek: 約1.5萬名跑手周日參賽後，反映缺水、天氣炎熱、路況不平及賽後取回物品需長途步行。

en.headline: Woman in her 50s dies after suspected hit-and-run on Castle Peak Road in Hung Shui Kiu
en.dek: Police said a passer-by found the woman unconscious in a planter near Chung Uk Tsuen Light Rail Stop at about 11.14pm on Monday; a male driver was later arrested.

zh.headline: 洪水橋青山公路疑撞人後不顧而去 五十多歲女子死亡 男司機被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一晚上約11時14分，途人在鐘屋村輕鐵站附近花槽發現女子昏迷，送院後不治；男司機其後被捕。

en.headline: Super Terminal Expo opens at AsiaWorld-Expo focusing on future transport hubs
en.dek: The three-day event organised by Informa Markets runs from 3 to 5 November with Hong Kong International Airport as principal partner, covering terminal design, automation and low-altitude economy.

zh.headline: 超級樞紐博覽會今起亞洲國際博覽館舉行 聚焦未來交通樞紐
zh.dek: Informa Markets主辦的三日活動由11月3日至5日舉行，香港國際機場為主要夥伴，涵蓋終端設計、自動化及低空經濟。

en.headline: Police arrest 61-year-old man over suspected drugging of DJ Mao Hamasaki in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The local man was held in Central on Monday on suspicion of administering poison with intent to injure after the former Japanese actress collapsed at a Mody Road venue on 1 November.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕61歲男子 涉尖沙咀懷疑落藥前AV女優濱崎真緒
zh.dek: 本地男子周一在中環被捕，涉嫌意圖傷害而施用毒藥；事件於11月1日凌晨在麼地道場地發生。

en.headline: Wang Xinyu advances at Hong Kong Tennis Open after straight-sets win
en.dek: The sixth seed defeated wild-card Adithya Karunaratne 6-1, 6-1 in the first round at Victoria Park on Monday.

zh.headline: 王欣瑜保誠香港網球公開賽首輪直落兩盤晉級
zh.dek: 六號種子周一在維多利亞公園以6-1、6-1擊敗香港外卡卡魯納拉特納，晉級次輪。

en.headline: Jazz quartet Aziza with Dave Holland performs at City Hall tonight
en.dek: The supergroup of Holland, Chris Potter, Lionel Loueke and Eric Harland marks the 10th anniversary of its album with an 8pm concert at Hong Kong City Hall Concert Hall.

zh.headline: 爵士超級組合Aziza今晚香港大會堂演出 Dave Holland領軍
zh.dek: 由Dave Holland、Chris Potter、Lionel Loueke及Eric Harland組成的四重奏，將於晚上8時在香港大會堂音樂廳演出，紀念專輯十周年。

en.headline: Customs seize 5.1kg cannabis buds and other items at airport, arrest man
en.dek: A 42-year-old mainland passenger from Bangkok was arrested after officers found suspected cannabis, Part I poisons and duty-not-paid cigarettes worth about HK$1.06 million.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5.1公斤大麻花蕾等物品 拘捕一名男子
zh.dek: 一名42歲內地旅客由曼谷抵港，海關在其手提行李發現懷疑大麻、第I部毒藥及未完稅香煙，市值約106萬元。

en.headline: Korean band LUCY holds Island encore concert at Kitty Woo Stadium tonight
en.dek: The group performs at 7pm on Tuesday at Tung Po's Kitty Woo Stadium as part of its ninth concert tour encore, with tickets previously sold via Cityline.

zh.headline: 韓國樂隊LUCY今晚東蒲胡李名靜體育館舉行Island安可演唱會
zh.dek: 樂隊周二晚上7時在東蒲體育館演出，作為第九次演唱會巡演安可場，門票早前經Cityline發售。

en.headline: Meta says it met Hong Kong privacy watchdog over AI glasses concerns
en.dek: The company briefed media after the Privacy Commissioner warned that smart glasses could enable covert recording and excessive data collection processed by AI.

zh.headline: Meta稱已就AI眼鏡私隱憂慮與私隱公署會面
zh.dek: 公司在私隱專員警告智能眼鏡可能導致隱蔽攝錄及AI處理過量資料後，向傳媒簡報。

en.headline: Study links Northern Metropolis land clearance to higher stray animal intakes
en.dek: Researchers found about 40 per cent of animals taken in by six rescue groups in the first half of the year came from the development area, with groups calling for policy review.

zh.headline: 研究指北部都會區收地與流浪動物接收量上升有關
zh.dek: 研究發現今年上半年六個救援組織接收的動物中約四成來自發展區，團體呼籲檢討政策。

en.headline: Sources say first national security law convict and three others released early
en.dek: Reports citing sources said Leon Tong Ying-kit, former Apple Daily publisher Cheung Kim-hung, Wayland Chan and Andy Li were granted early release after high-profile convictions.

zh.headline: 消息指首名國安法定罪者及三人獲提早釋放
zh.dek: 報道引述消息指唐英傑、前蘋果日報出版人張劍虹、陳梓華及李宇軒在高調定罪後獲提早釋放。

en.headline: Development Bureau submits Queen Mary Hospital lifts investigation report
en.dek: The bureau said it has given the report to the Chief Executive, who requested further details on rectification work, with 17 lifts repaired and seven now in use.

zh.headline: 發展局已向特首提交瑪麗醫院升降機調查報告
zh.dek: 局方指已提交報告，特首要求提供執修及後續行動進一步資料，17部升降機完成執修，7部已開放使用。

en.headline: High Court opens murder trial of man accused of killing yoga instructor
en.dek: Prosecutors told the jury that Alex Lo bought a knife and planned to kill his former girlfriend Aqua Chow at the Ritz-Carlton in 2022.

zh.headline: 高等法院開審瑜伽導師遭殺案 被告否認謀殺
zh.dek: 控方告訴陪審團，被告羅俊明購入刀具，計劃於2022年在麗思卡爾頓酒店殺死前女友周慧賢。

en.headline: Court of Final Appeal refuses Gregory Wong leave to appeal LegCo riot conviction
en.dek: The Appeal Committee found the actor had not raised reasonably arguable grounds to challenge his conviction and six-year-two-month sentence for the 2019 storming.

zh.headline: 終審法院拒絕黃秋生就立法會暴動案提出上訴許可
zh.dek: 上訴委員會裁定演員未能提出合理可爭辯理由，挑戰其因2019年衝擊立法會被定罪及判囚六年兩個月。

en.headline: Nine injured in three-vehicle collision on Tsuen Wan Road in Kwai Chung
en.dek: Police said two private cars and a minibus collided near Kwai Shun Street Playground at about 7.29pm, leaving nine minibus passengers with minor injuries.

zh.headline: 荃灣路葵涌三車相撞九人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一晚上約7時29分，兩輛私家車與一輛小巴在葵涌葵順街遊樂場附近相撞，小巴上九名乘客輕傷。

en.headline: Police arrest man after hit-and-run at Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge checkpoint
en.dek: A man in his thirties was held in Tuen Mun after a car struck a barrier at the checkpoint overnight and officers intercepted the vehicle following a chase.

zh.headline: 私家車港珠澳大橋口岸撞閘不顧而去 警方屯門截車拘捕三十多歲男子
zh.dek: 一輛私家車凌晨在港珠澳大橋口岸撞到檢查亭閘後逃走，警方早上在屯門截獲車輛，拘捕一名三十多歲男子。

en.headline: Burglars steal watches and jewellery worth HK$440,000 from Sai Kung house
en.dek: A domestic helper discovered a pried-open window at a detached house in Nam Shan San Tsuen while the owners were overseas, with items including an H. Stern watch missing.

zh.headline: 西貢南山新村獨立屋遭撬窗爆竊 失約44萬元珠寶手錶
zh.dek: 屋主一家身在海外，外傭清晨發現房間窗戶被撬，屋內有搜掠痕跡，損失包括一隻H.Stern手錶及其他首飾。

en.headline: Industry says new renovation council will draw legitimate contractors back
en.dek: Representatives from the renovation sector said the Building Maintenance Support and Services Council’s integrity checks would help restore order and encourage qualified firms to return to the market.

zh.headline: 業界指新維修監察機構有助吸引合規承辦商重返市場
zh.dek: 裝修業界代表表示，樓宇維修支援及服務委員會的誠信審查將有助恢復市場秩序，鼓勵合資格公司重新參與。

en.headline: HKMAO calls for stronger systems to bring in competent patriotic governance talent
en.dek: The Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office said in a People’s Daily article that Hong Kong should improve training, selection, appointment and management to build a governing team with integrity and competence.

zh.headline: 港澳辦文章促完善機制吸納德才兼備管治人才
zh.dek: 國務院港澳辦理論學習組在《人民日報》發表文章，指香港應完善培養、選拔、任用和管理機制，建設有德有才的管治隊伍。

en.headline: Red flag hoisted at Big Wave Bay Beach due to large waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the red flag was raised at Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District on Monday morning because of big waves, advising beachgoers not to swim.

zh.headline: 大浪灣泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康樂及文化事務署表示，因大浪於周一大浪灣泳灘懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要游泳。

en.headline: Hands Percussion brings Taksu gamelan concert to Sha Tin Town Hall this week
en.dek: Malaysia’s Hands Percussion and Indonesia’s Gamelan Yuganada perform Taksu – The Spirit of Gamelan on 6 and 7 November as part of the Asia+ Festival, with the Hong Kong Children’s Choir joining.

zh.headline: 馬來西亞人人人鼓劇場《銅話鼓事》本周沙田大會堂上演
zh.dek: 人人人鼓劇場與印尼甘美蘭樂團於11月6及7日在沙田大會堂演出《銅話鼓事》，香港兒童合唱團亦參與重新譯繹民謠，屬亞藝無疆藝術節節目。

en.headline: SFC plans cybersecurity framework for licensed firms with stricter rules for higher risk
en.dek: Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung outlined the plan at Hong Kong FinTech Week, saying the framework would set baseline requirements and enhanced measures for higher-risk licensed institutions.

zh.headline: 證監會擬為持牌機構制訂網絡保安架構 風險較高者須符合更高要求
zh.dek: 行政總裁梁鳳儀在香港金融科技周表示，架構會為所有持牌機構訂定基線要求，並對風險較高機構實施加強措施，以應對人工智能相關威脅。

en.headline: John Lee to visit Beijing and Shanghai for symposium and CIIE
en.dek: The Chief Executive departs tomorrow for the 29th Beijing-Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium and the ninth China International Import Expo, returning on November 6.

zh.headline: 李家超明赴北京上海出席京港洽談會及進博會
zh.dek: 行政長官周二出發，出席第29屆京港經濟合作研討洽談會及第9屆中國國際進口博覽會，預計11月6日返港。

en.headline: Sun Dong departs for World Internet Conference in Wuzhen
en.dek: The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry left for Zhejiang on Monday afternoon to attend the summit, where he will speak at forums on AI agents and cross-strait internet development.

zh.headline: 孫東啟程赴烏鎮出席世界互聯網大會峰會
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長周一下午出發前往浙江，將出席峰會並在智能體及兩岸港澳互聯網發展論壇致辭。

en.headline: UNIDROIT opens first Asia-Pacific liaison office in Hong Kong
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee welcomed the institute’s first overseas presence as Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 began, calling the city an ideal home for regional private-law work.

zh.headline: 國際統一私法協會亞太聯絡辦正式在港開幕
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超歡迎協會百年來首個海外辦公室落戶香港，並為法律周2026揭幕，形容本港是推動區域私法工作的理想地點。

en.headline: HSBC plans AI and emerging technology institute in Northern Metropolis
en.dek: The bank aims to open the centre in the first quarter of 2027 with HKUST as anchor partner, later relocating it to the Northern Metropolis.

zh.headline: 滙豐計劃在北部都會區成立人工智能研究院
zh.dek: 銀行擬於2027年首季投入運作，以香港科技大學為主要學術夥伴，並於場地就緒後遷往北都。

en.headline: ICAC charges two former cleaning firm executives over HK$75 million bribes
en.dek: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged William Fung and Jimmy Lee with conspiracy to accept advantages linked to cleaning vehicle contracts.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴兩名前清潔公司高層涉收賄逾7500萬元
zh.dek: 廉政公署控告封志宏及李細亮串謀使代理人接受利益，涉莊臣清潔公司採購清潔車輚及維修服務。

en.headline: The Pizza Bar by Daniele Cason opens at Mandarin Oriental Hong Kong
en.dek: The counter-style pizza omakase from the Tokyo venue ranked No. 2 by 50 Top Pizza in 2025 begins service on Monday at the hotel’s mezzanine in Central.

zh.headline: 文華東方酒店The Pizza Bar by Daniele Cason周一開業
zh.dek: 來自東京、2025年獲50 Top Pizza評為全球第二的廚師發辦薄餅吧，周一於中環酒店夾層正式開業。

en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens at Cultural Centre this week
en.dek: The Broadway production of the Roald Dahl story runs from 4 November to 6 December at the Grand Theatre, performed in English with Chinese surtitles.

zh.headline: 《朱古力獎門人》音樂劇本周於文化中心開演
zh.dek: 百老匯版羅爾德·達爾故事改編音樂劇由11月4日至12月6日在香港文化中心大劇院上演，英語演出配繁體中文字幕。

en.headline: Police arrest driver after finding suspected drugs in Wan Chai car
en.dek: Officers stopped a private car near 221 Gloucester Road early Monday and seized small amounts of suspected methamphetamine, cocaine and cannabis; a 34-year-old man was arrested for trafficking.

zh.headline: 警灣仔截查私家車檢懷疑毒品 拘34歲男司機
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨在告士打道221號對開截查一輛私家車，檢獲少量懷疑冰毒、可卡因及大麻花，34歲非華裔男司機涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。

en.headline: Inter-Island Festival returns for third edition across outlying islands
en.dek: The month-long event under the theme ArchipelaGO!GO! runs from 1 to 29 November on Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Mui Wo and Chi Ma Wan, with workshops, tours and exhibitions.

zh.headline: 第三屆船到橋頭生活節展開 以群島共生串連離島
zh.dek: 活動由11月1日至29日在長洲、坪洲、梅窩及芝麻灣舉行，包括工作坊、導賞及展覽。

en.headline: Police treat Shek Kong road incident as criminal damage after object thrown at car
en.dek: A 19-year-old driver reported that a man in black threw a hard object at his BMW near Route Twisk around 1am on Monday; officers are seeking the man.

zh.headline: 石崗荃錦公路有人向私家車擲物 警列刑事毀壞跟進
zh.dek: 19歲司機指周一凌晨約1時有黑衣男子向其寶馬擲硬物，警方正尋找涉事男子。

en.headline: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK opens at HKCEC
en.dek: The five-day event, expected to draw over 45,000 participants from more than 120 economies, begins on Monday with the main conference at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

zh.headline: 香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK今日開幕
zh.dek: 為期五日的活動預計吸引來自超過120個經濟體逾4.5萬名與會者，主論壇周一在香港會議展覽中心展開。

en.headline: Liantang Port records over 100 million passenger crossings in six years
en.dek: Shenzhen border authorities said the Heung Yuen Wai/Liantang checkpoint has handled more than 100 million inbound and outbound passenger trips and over 6 million vehicles since opening.

zh.headline: 蓮塘口岸開通六年累計出入境人次突破1億
zh.dek: 深圳出入境邊防檢查總站表示，蓮塘/香園圍口岸自開通以來已查驗超過1億人次及600萬架次車輛。

en.headline: Hong Kong Tennis Open main draw begins at Victoria Park
en.dek: The Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open main-draw matches start on Monday at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium, with Venus Williams among the players on the opening day schedule.

zh.headline: 香港網球公開賽正賽今日在維園開打
zh.dek: 保誠香港網球公開賽單打正賽周一在維多利亞公園網球場展開，開幕日賽程包括維納斯·威廉姆斯的比賽。

en.headline: Bar Association backs criminalising bid-rigging and proposes about 50 law changes
en.dek: The Hong Kong Bar Association's Tai Po fire task force report, released on Sunday, supports a dual civil-criminal track under the Competition Ordinance while urging clear definitions, and suggests dual-envelope…

zh.headline: 大律師公會支持圍標刑事化 提約50項修例建議
zh.dek: 大律師公會大埔火災法律研究小組周日發表報告，原則支持修訂《競爭條例》將圍標刑事化，並與現行民事執法雙軌並行，同時促請罪行元素定義清晰，並建議法團大型工程採雙信封投標。

en.headline: Expert says many flu patients deteriorating faster this season, research under way
en.dek: Former Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases president Kwan Yat-wah noted higher influenza A activity and rapid worsening in some patients, including children with low blood pressure or encephalitis, and…

zh.headline: 關日華指今季流感患者病情轉差較快 正研究病毒基因變化
zh.dek: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會前會長關日華表示，近期甲型流感活躍，今季不少患者病情較快惡化，部分兒童出現血壓低、腦炎等，正研究是否與病毒基因改變有關。

en.headline: Police seize about 9kg of suspected cannabis from mainland man at airport
en.dek: A 22-year-old man was arrested on Sunday morning after officers found roughly 30 packs of cannabis flowers in his luggage and backpack, with an estimated street value of HK$1.3 million.

zh.headline: 機場截查22歲內地男 檢約9公斤懷疑大麻花 市值130萬
zh.dek: 西九龍反三合會人員周日早上在入境大堂截查，於男子行李箱及背包內檢獲約30包懷疑大麻花，他涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026 carnival ends today at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free two-day opening event at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre piazza featured pixelated old Hong Kong installations including a giant egg tart and a traditional medicine shop.

zh.headline: 香港博物館節2026開幕嘉年華今日結束 文化中心露天廣場
zh.dek: 一連兩日免費活動以「拼貼今昔，香港故事」為主題，設有格仔茶檔、巨型像素蛋撻及傳統中藥舖等裝置。

en.headline: Police arrest private car driver after motorcycle collision in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A motorcyclist was trapped under a private car near King Lam Estate around noon on Sunday and later rescued conscious; the car driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.

zh.headline: 將軍澳私家車與電單車相撞 鐵騎士一度困車底 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周日中午佳景路近景林邨發生碰撞，電單車男司機被捲入車底獲救，清醒送院；私家車男司機涉嫌危險駕駛被捕。

en.headline: Customs seize about 6kg of suspected cocaine from Filipino passenger at airport
en.dek: A 22-year-old woman arriving from Phnom Penh was arrested and charged with drug trafficking; the case is due in court on Monday.

zh.headline: 海關在機場檢獲約6公斤懷疑可卡因 拘菲籍女旅客
zh.dek: 22歲女子由金邊抵港，已被控販運危險藥物，案件明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Observatory says Hong Kong recorded its warmest October since 1884
en.dek: Mean maximum, mean and mean minimum temperatures all set October records, attributed to an extremely strong El Nino and other factors.

zh.headline: 天文台：香港經歷1884年以來最暖10月
zh.dek: 平均最高、平均及平均最低氣溫均打破歷來10月紀錄，天文台指與極強厄爾尼諾等有關。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival draws crowds on final day at Central Harbourfront
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board ends today, with exhibitors reporting sales growth and Guangdong industry visitors attending.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮閉幕日吸引大批市民遊客
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動今日結束，部分展商銷情錄得增長，廣東業界人士進場觀摩。

en.headline: Hospital Authority says 23 people hospitalised after Northern Metropolis Marathon
en.dek: The Authority reported the figure as of 3:10pm on Sunday for the inaugural event that drew about 15,000 runners.

zh.headline: 醫管局稱北都馬拉松至少23人受傷入院
zh.dek: 醫管局表示截至周日下午3時10分，有23人因賽事受傷入院治理，是次活動約有1.5萬人參與。

en.headline: Police investigate suspected drink spiking after Japanese DJ hospitalised in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: Former adult film actress Mao Hamasaki, now working as a DJ, is in intensive care after tests showed positive reactions to four types of drugs, police said.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀私竇打碟疑遭落藥 日籍DJ送ICU 警列施用毒藥調查
zh.dek: 前日本AV女優濱崎真緒現以DJ身分在港工作，院方驗出體內對四種藥物呈陽性反應，警方正跟進。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly cloudy conditions with light rain patches for the work week
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects the easterly airstream to moderate on Monday, bringing sunny periods, before another airstream brings windier weather with light rain midweek.

zh.headline: 天文台預測本周工作日大致多雲 間中有微雨
zh.dek: 天文台表示偏東氣流明日會緩和，帶來部分時間有陽光，其後另一股偏東氣流會令本周中期風勢較大及有一兩陣雨。

en.headline: Lee tells scouts Hong Kong offers unlimited opportunities under One Country Two Systems
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee, as Chief Scout, outlined four expectations for young people at the Hong Kong Scout Association rally on Sunday.

zh.headline: 李家超以童軍總領袖身分籲青年把握一國兩制機遇
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超周日出席香港童軍大會操，提出胸懷家國、放眼世界、錘鍊意志及助人為樂四點期望。

en.headline: Heritage Fiesta 2026 guided tours of Northern Metropolis buildings begin today
en.dek: Free guided tours and open visits to 12 historic sites in the Northern Metropolis run until 31 December, organised by the Commissioner for Heritage's Office.

zh.headline: 2026古蹟周遊樂今日起辦北都歷史建築導賞
zh.dek: 文物保育專員辦事處主辦的免費導賞團及參觀活動，涵蓋北部都會區12處歷史建築，持續至12月31日。

en.headline: Three Hong Kong newspapers raise cover prices by HK$3 this month
en.dek: Ming Pao rose to HK$15 from Sunday, while the Hong Kong Economic Times and Hong Kong Economic Journal will follow on Monday.

zh.headline: 三份本地報章本月加價3元 明報今起調至15元
zh.dek: 明報由周日每份12元加至15元，經濟日報及信報則由周一起分別加至15元及18元。

en.headline: Hong Kong Sixes reaches finals day with Cup final set for afternoon
en.dek: Afghanistan and Australia meet in the Cup final at Mission Road Ground, while classification matches continue through the morning.

zh.headline: 香港六人板球賽決賽日 阿富汗對澳洲爭冠
zh.dek: 阿富汗與澳洲將在旺角美善道運動場進行盃賽決賽，分類賽繼續在上午舉行。

en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning as risk stays high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Sunday, urging the public to take precautions and hikers to stay vigilant.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火警風險高
zh.dek: 天文台周日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，提醒市民小心防火，郊遊人士提高警覺。

en.headline: First Northern Metropolis Marathon starts with about 15000 runners
en.dek: The full marathon began at 6:30am from the Heung Yee Kuk building in Sha Tin, with routes including the Lung Shan Tunnel and a first-time finish on Fanling Bypass.

zh.headline: 首屆北部都會區馬拉松今早開跑 約1.5萬人參與
zh.dek: 全馬賽事早上6時半在沙田石門新界鄉議局大樓起步，途經龍山隧道，並以首次開放的粉嶺繞道作終點。

en.headline: Police arrest father after 14-year-old boy injured in Sheung Wan
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of ill-treatment of a child after the boy suffered injuries to his eyes, hands and forehead at a flat on Hospital Road.

zh.headline: 西營盤14歲男童疑遭父親管教受傷 35歲父涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 警方凌晨接報後到醫院道18號調查，男童眼、手及額頭受傷清醒送院，父親涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕。

en.headline: Police treat fire that burned nine bicycles in Hang Hau as arson
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished the blaze at a public bicycle parking bay on Po Ning Road shortly after 1am; no one was injured and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 將軍澳寶寧路公共單車泊位9輛單車焚毀 警列縱火案追查
zh.dek: 凌晨約1時有途人發現單車起火，消防員將火救熄，現場9輛單車被毀，暫無人被捕。
